denied.title: You do not have access to this page
denied.body: Your role or organization does not include this area. If you think you should have access, ask your organization manager or contact support.

notFound.title: We could not find that record
notFound.body: It may have been removed, or it belongs to another organization.

gated.title: This screen is not connected yet
gated.body: There is no live connection for this screen yet, so nothing is shown here. No data has been changed.

workspace.heading: Your organizations
workspace.chooseBody: You work with more than one organization. Choose one to continue. Records from different organizations are never shown together.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Feature gates as the server sees them. They change only through the approved release process, never from this screen.

gate.clinical: Clinical records and lab report release

dashboard.title: Admin overview
dashboard.description: Work waiting for you. Only areas you are assigned are shown, with counts from current records.
dashboard.allClear: Nothing needs your action right now.
dashboard.noAreasBody: Your account has no admin capabilities yet. Ask an admin lead to assign them.

bookings.title: Booking operations
bookings.description: Look up a booking by its reference. This view is read-only: you cannot accept, edit or change a booking's status here.
bookings.invalid: Enter a valid booking reference, for example #SCV-BKG-000142.
bookings.exceptionsEmptyBody: Booking exceptions such as failed handovers or interrupted trips appear here.

users.title: Admins and invites
users.description: Admin access is by invitation only. You cannot change your own access.
users.suspendBody: They lose admin access at once. Choose the reason; it is kept in the audit log.
users.done: Saved. The list has been updated.
users.emptyBody: Admins appear here after they accept an invitation.

payments.title: Payments and refunds
payments.description: Payment records, kept separate from booking status. Amounts come from the server.
payments.liveOff: Live online payments are switched off. No card or UPI payment can be taken online.
payments.refundGated: Refund approval is not available yet. It needs an approved refund policy and a live payment account.
payments.emptyBody: Payment records appear here once bookings have amounts due.

support.title: Support queue
support.description: Tickets by owner and status. The provider answers first; unresolved tickets are escalated to the platform.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what and when. Secrets, contact details and health information are never shown.

publishBlocked.consentRequired: A story can be published only with consent evidence, or after confirming it shows no identifiable person.

cms.title: Content
cms.description: Stories, FAQs and pages for the public site. Drafts go to preview, and only a publisher can publish.
cms.emptyBody: Create a story, FAQ or page to start.

fields.slugHint: Lower-case letters, numbers and hyphens, for example how-booking-works
fields.title: Title
fields.bodyHint: Plain text. Use ## for a heading, - for a list, **bold**, *italic* and [text](/en/page) for links. HTML is not allowed.
fields.question: Question
fields.consentHint: The ID of the signed consent record for the person in this story.
fields.noIdentifiablePerson: This story shows no identifiable person

errors.html_forbidden: HTML and markup are not allowed. Use plain text.
errors.unsafe_link: That link is not allowed. Use a path like /en/faq or an https address.

confirm.publishBody: It replaces what the public site shows for this language.
confirm.archiveBody: It is removed from the public site for this language.

cms.actionDone: Saved. The page has been updated.
cms.previewLive: This is the version the public site shows.
cms.previewNotLive: Not live yet. The public site shows the last published version, if any.
cms.noVersion: This language has no version yet. Save a draft to create one.

reviews.title: Review moderation
reviews.description: Check patient reviews before they are published. Reviews show the booking reference and provider only, never the patient.
reviews.count: {count, plural, =0 {No reviews} one {# review} other {# reviews}}
reviews.stars: {rating, plural, one {# star out of 5} other {# stars out of 5}}
reviews.rejectLabel: Do not publish the review for booking {reference}
reviews.rejectBody: The patient sees the reason you choose. They can edit the review and send it again.
reviews.rejected: Review not published. The patient will see the reason.
reviews.conflict: This review was already decided or changed. The list has been refreshed.

empty.pending_moderation: No reviews are waiting for moderation.
empty.rejected: No reviews have been turned down.

reviews.gated: Review moderation is not connected yet. Nothing here is saved.
